name: suburi-wakeword
description: Wake word training and voice collection pipeline for Stack-chan experiments.

scripts.pipeline:test: cd training/pipeline && PYTHONPATH=src uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
scripts.pipeline:smoke: cd training/pipeline && PYTHONPATH=src uv run python -m suburi_wakeword.run_smoke_pipeline
scripts.voice:collect: cd training/pipeline && PYTHONPATH=src uv run python -m suburi_wakeword.voice_collection_server --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8787
